description: Source code for the PlaidConnector class, which interfaces with the Plaid API for banking data integration within the ERPNext system.

classes.name: PlaidConnector
classes.description: A class to handle interactions with the Plaid API, including obtaining access tokens, creating link tokens, and fetching transactions.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the PlaidConnector with optional access token and sets up API client.

methods.name: get_access_token
methods.description: Exchanges a public token for an access token.

methods.name: get_token_request
methods.description: Prepares request parameters for creating a Plaid link token.

methods.name: get_link_token
methods.description: Creates and returns a Plaid link token, handling errors.

methods.name: auth
methods.description: Performs authentication check with Plaid API, handling various errors.

methods.name: get_transactions
methods.description: Fetches transactions within a date range, optionally for a specific account.
